news.title: Analysis: How Chelsea reversed scoring fortunes with emphatic Man Utd display
news.title_zh: 分析：切尔西如何凭借曼联的强势表现扭转进球命运
news.body_en: Chelsea responded in style to the disappointing 1-1 draw with Aston Villa on the opening day of the Women's Super League season by putting five goals past Manchester United away from home without reply. Against Villa, the Blues had created plenty, firing 35 shots towards the opposition's goal, with the data revealing we created an xG (Expected Goals) rating of 3.6. Yet we found the back of the net just once, and a late equaliser from the visitors meant we came away with just one point to show from such a dominant display. After the match, head coach Sonia Bompastor explained why clinical finishing is so important. 'The reality of football is that in this kind of game, we need to be two or three-nil up by half-time, and the game is over,' she said in her post-match press conference. 'Then, it's a completely different game coming into the second half because when you have two or three goals difference, you can bring players in, rotate the squad.' Her words acted as a prophecy of sorts as the Blues raced into a 2-0 lead by half-time against Manchester United thanks to goals from Sjoeke Nusken and Keira Walsh. Lauren James promptly added a third on the hour mark. True to what she explained the previous week, Bompastor made a triple substitution in the 71st minute, rotating James, Katie McCabe and Alyssa Thompson for Sandy Baltimore, Veerle Buurman and Maika Hamano, before goals from Ellie Carpenter and Lucy Bronze completed the rout. Here's a look at how we turned our fortunes around. Against Villa, we created enough chances to produce an xG rating of 3.6, but netted only once. In contrast, we produced a rating of 2.94 against Manchester United but outscored that number with five goals on the day. After the match, Wieke Kaptein explained that the Blues had been working on crossing through the week in training, and that approach certainly paid off. The stats reveal that clinical finishing made the difference against the Red Devils, as we scored five times from 25 shots on goal and 30 crosses. Against Villa, we scored once from ten more shots (35) and 11 more crosses (41), showing that quality over quantity was key to our success at the Progress With Unity Stadium. Keen to ensure we took all three points away from Manchester, Bompastor played an aggressive formation. Katie McCabe and Lucy Bronze pushed up high, leaving just Kadeisha Buchanan from the back three to stay deep and alert to the danger of counter-attacks. McCabe and Bronze supported a double-pivot midfield made up of Lexi Potter and Keira Walsh, while we went for an all-out attack with a front five of Ellie Carpenter, Kaptein, James, Nusken and Alyssa Thompson. Meanwhile, Manchester United were playing only their second match under new boss Eva Olid since parting ways with longstanding head coach Marc Skinner in the summer. Bompastor's ruthless approach gave a side attempting to implement a new style of play no choice but to retreat backwards to deal with the constant goal threats from our talented front five, as the graphic below shows. The home side were reduced to an xG of 0.20, attempting just two shots on goal and taking only four touches in our box. Our all-out attacking approach may not be the correct solution for every match, but on Sunday it worked perfectly. Not only did we secure all three points, but the performance will have undoubtedly boosted the team's confidence in the shooting department. While Kaptein was not among the scorers on Sunday, her determined performance was crucial to the win. Unselfishly working to make the attack click, the Netherlands international created the most chances of anyone during the afternoon (four), and also regained possession more than any other Chelsea player, winning the ball back on ten separate occasions. Her tenacity allowed us to keep up the relentless pressure up front, also winning three aerial duels and making 24 passes in the final third of the pitch. ‘We kept possession a little bit longer, saw where the spaces were,' Kaptein said afterwards. 'Then I think a lot of people were in front of the goal, which was really good. So every time they came across or when there was an opportunity, I think everyone was ready for it.' Usually known for her elite skills in the holding midfield role, Keira Walsh made a strong display in attack during what was her 50th appearance for Chelsea in our 5-0 win on Sunday. Scoring with a beautifully-struck effort from outside the box to put us two goals in front, Walsh also assisted James after 61 minutes and won the Player of the Match trophy for her performance. The heat map below shows how she got forward into shooting range, in particular the right-hand side of the final third. Ordinarily, if Walsh were to make forward runs like those indicated on the heat map, she would be leaving a gaping hole in front of the defence.  Yet the experienced England international was free to advance, thanks to her midfield partner and Chelsea Academy graduate Lexi Potter. The 20-year-old had the highest pass completion rate of the entire team (91.7 per cent from 48 attempts), showing that she was careful with the ball and executed her role in the system perfectly. ‘Lexi deserves to get minutes in this team,' said Bompastor afterwards. 'She's a really good player. Sometimes it depends on the tactics, the different profiles we want to use and the different systems we are playing. But it was a good opportunity for her, and she had a good performance.' On this occasion, our head coach trusted Potter to keep the ball moving, without losing possession in dangerous areas. She did exactly that, which in turn allowed her midfield partner Walsh to have so much success in attack. Don't miss our huge London derby clash against Arsenal at Stamford Bridge! Secure your seat now...
news.body_zh: 切尔西在女足超级联赛揭幕战中以 1-1 战平阿斯顿维拉的方式做出了令人失望的回应，他们在客场以 5 粒进球击败了曼联，但没有取得任何回应。对阵维拉的比赛中，蓝军创造了很多机会，向对手的球门射门 35 次，数据显示我们创造了 3.6 的 xG（预期进球）评分。然而我们只扳回一球，而且客队在最后时刻扳平比分，这意味着我们在如此具有统治力的表现中只得到了一分。赛后，主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特解释了为什么临床终结如此重要。她在赛后新闻发布会上说，足球的现实是，在这种比赛中，我们需要在半场结束时以两比三领先，然后比赛就结束了。 “然后，进入下半场，这是一场完全不同的比赛，因为当你有两到三个净胜球的差距时，你可以引进球员，轮换阵容。”她的话就像是预言一样，凭借舍克·努斯肯和凯拉·沃尔什的进球，蓝军在半场结束时以 2-0 领先曼联。劳伦·詹姆斯 (Lauren James) 立即在小时标记上添加了第三个。正如她上周所解释的那样，邦帕斯特在第 71 分钟进行了三次换人，用詹姆斯、凯蒂·麦凯布和阿丽莎·汤普森换下桑迪·巴尔的摩、维尔勒·布尔曼和麦卡·哈马诺，然后埃莉·卡彭特和露西·布朗泽的进球完成了溃败。以下是我们如何扭转命运的。对阵维拉时，我们创造了足够的机会，xG 值为 3.6，但只进了一次球。相比之下，我们对阵曼联时的评分为 2.94，但当天我们以 5 个进球超越了这一数字。赛后，维克·卡普坦解释说，蓝军在这周的训练中一直在努力，这种方法肯定得到了回报。统计数据显示，在对阵红魔的比赛中，临床终结发挥了重要作用，我们在 25 次射门和 30 次传中中打进了 5 球。对阵维拉的比赛中，我们通过 10 次射门（35 次）和 11 次传中（41 次）进球，这表明质量胜于数量是我们在进步团结体育场取得成功的关键。为了确保我们从曼彻斯特队手中拿下全部三分，邦帕斯托尔打出了侵略性的阵型。凯蒂·麦凯布（Katie McCabe）和露西·布朗兹（Lucy Bronze）向前推进，后三名球员中只剩下卡黛莎·布坎南（Kadeisha Buchanan）留在后场，警惕反击的危险。麦凯布和布朗兹支持由莱克西·波特和凯拉·沃尔什组成的双枢轴中场，而我们则由艾莉·卡彭特、卡普坦、詹姆斯、努斯肯和阿丽莎·汤普森组成的前五人全力进攻。与此同时，曼联自去年夏天与长期担任主教练的马克·斯金纳分道扬镳后，这只是新任主帅伊娃·奥利德执教下的第二场比赛。庞帕斯特的无情手段让试图实施新打法的球队别无选择，只能向后撤退，以应对来自我们才华横溢的前五名的持续进球威胁，如下图所示。主队的预期进球率降至 0.20，仅尝试两次射门，在禁区内仅触球四次。我们全力以赴的进攻方式可能不是每场比赛的正确解决方案，但周日的比赛效果非常好。我们不仅全取三分，而且这样的表现无疑增强了球队对投篮的信心。虽然卡普坦不在周日的得分手之列，但她坚定的表现对胜利至关重要。这位荷兰国脚无私地努力发动进攻，在整个下午创造了最多的机会（四次），并且也比任何其他切尔西球员都更多地重新获得控球权，十次夺回球权。她的坚韧让我们能够在前场保持无情的压力，还赢得了 3 次空中对抗，并在球场的最后三分之一区域传出 24 次传球。 “我们把控球时间延长了一点，看看哪里有空间，”卡普坦后来说。 “然后我认为很多人都在球门前，这真的很好。所以每次他们遇到或者有机会的时候，我想每个人都已经做好了准备。”凯拉·沃尔什通常以其在中场位置上的出色技术而闻名，她在周日 5-0 战胜切尔西的比赛中，在她代表切尔西出场 50 次的比赛中，在进攻中表现出色。 沃尔什在禁区外一脚漂亮的射门帮助我们取得两球领先，她还在第61分钟后助攻詹姆斯，并凭借她的表现赢得了全场最佳球员奖杯。下面的热图显示了她如何向前进入投篮范围，特别是最后三分之一的右侧。通常情况下，如果沃尔什像热图上所示那样向前跑动，她就会在防守面前留下一个大漏洞。然而，由于她的中场搭档、切尔西学院毕业生莱克西·波特的帮助，这位经验丰富的英格兰国脚得以自由晋级。这位20岁的球员的传球成功率是全队最高的（48次传球，成功率为91.7%），这表明她对球的小心谨慎，完美地履行了自己在体系中的角色。 “莱克西值得在这支球队中获得上场时间，”邦帕斯特赛后说道。 “她是一位非常出色的球员。有时这取决于战术、我们想要使用的不同配置文件以及我们正在玩的不同系统。但这对她来说是一个很好的机会，而且她也有很好的表现。”这次，我们的主教练相信波特能够保持球的移动，而不会在危险区域失去控球权。她正是这样做的，这反过来又让她的中场搭档沃尔什在进攻上取得了巨大的成功。不要错过我们在斯坦福桥对阵阿森纳的伦敦德比大战！赶紧抢座位吧……

news.title: Joao Pedro explains why his connection with Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers works so well
news.title_zh: 若昂·佩德罗解释了为什么他与科尔·帕尔默和摩根·罗杰斯的关系如此密切
news.body_en: There has been no shortage of quality attacking football from the Blues so far this season. Eighteen goals scored in six games is proof of that. And it's the attacking trio of Joao Pedro, Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers chiefly responsible for our dynamism in the final third. They have scored ten goals and provided ten assists between them, regularly combining to devastating effect. Joao Pedro leads the attack with Rogers to his left and Palmer his right, but the trio’s fluidity and flexibility allow them to interchange, dragging defenders out of position and creating space for others. With a goal and an assist apiece in our games against Fulham, Brighton and Hull, Joao Pedro has picked up where he left off last term. And the Brazilian appreciates that one of the reasons for his own good form is having Palmer and Rogers beside him. He has explained how the trio combines. ‘Cole can score, he can pass, he can score from free-kicks, he can do everything,’ said Joao Pedro. ‘He's a different player. That's what makes him special. I just have to be ready when he gets the ball. I need to be in the right position to make the run, because he's going to make a brilliant pass, so I have to be ready to score. Because if not, later he's going to say, "Hey, Joao, you need to give me an assist!” ‘Morgan is a very skilful player,’ added our No.9. ‘We can see he can dribble past two, three guys, and carry the ball. That's what we expect from him, and I think he has started very well. ‘With Cole, I try to always give the ball to his feet. With Morgan it’s more to the space, or to let him in a one-v-one situation. And my job is just to run, and then they’re going to find me!’ Joao Pedro says the three have built a great connection off the pitch, too, which is helping their understanding when they take to the grass. He feels the central striker position enables him to showcase his myriad of skills and ‘be more dangerous’ by spending time in the opposition box. ‘Also,’ Joao jokes, ‘imagine if I try to play as a number ten, I need to fight positions with Cole Palmer! So it’s better if I stay as a nine’ The Blues’ final assignment before the upcoming, prolonged international break – when Joao Pedro will feature for Brazil once more – takes us a short way west, to Brentford. Joao Pedro clearly has plenty of confidence in the team’s ability to find the net, so if we can improve defensively then our hopes of returning home with three points increases. ‘Everyone wants to score, and Xabi (Alonso) tells us always, it doesn't matter what happens, you just need to be focused and be connected to the game and you're going to score. ‘That's why we score many goals this season from the beginning, because I think in the front three you can create a lot. And if you create a lot, you’re going to score a lot of goals as well.’
news.body_zh: 本赛季到目前为止，蓝军并不缺乏高质量的攻势足球。六场比赛打进十八球就是证明。若昂·佩德罗、科尔·帕尔默和摩根·罗杰斯组成的进攻三人组为我们在进攻三区的活力发挥了主要作用。他们一共打进了十个进球并提供了十次助攻，经常结合起来产生毁灭性的效果。若昂·佩德罗带领进攻，罗杰斯在左，帕尔默在右，但这三人的流动性和灵活性使他们能够互换，将防守者拖出位置，并为其他人创造空间。若昂·佩德罗在对阵富勒姆、布莱顿和赫尔城的比赛中各进一球并贡献一次助攻，继续了上赛季的表现。巴西人意识到，他自己状态良好的原因之一就是有帕尔默和罗杰斯在他身边。他解释了三人组如何结合。 “科尔可以得分，他可以传球，他可以通过任意球得分，他可以做一切，”若奥·佩德罗说。 ‘他是一个不同的球员。这就是他的特别之处。当他拿到球时我必须做好准备。我需要处于正确的位置才能跑动，因为他会传出精彩的传球，所以我必须准备好得分。因为如果没有，稍后他会说：“嘿，若奥，你需要给我一个帮助！” “摩根是一位技术非常精湛的球员，”我们的九号补充道。 “我们可以看到他可以运球过掉两三个人，并带球。这就是我们对他的期望，我认为他的起步非常好。 “对于科尔，我总是尽量把球传到他的脚下。对于摩根来说，更多的是为了空间，或者让他处于一对一的情况下。我的工作就是跑动，然后他们就会找到我！”若昂·佩德罗说，三人在场外也建立了良好的联系，这有助于他们在草地上时的理解。他认为中锋的位置使他能够展示自己的多种技能，并通过在对方禁区呆上时间来“变得更加危险”。 “另外，”若奥开玩笑说，“想象一下，如果我尝试打十号位，我需要与科尔·帕尔默争夺位置！因此，在即将到来的长期国际比赛日之前，如果我留在蓝军的最后一场九场比赛中，那就更好了——届时若昂·佩德罗将再次为巴西队出场——带我们向西走一小段路，前往布伦特福德。若昂·佩德罗显然对球队的进球能力充满信心，所以如果我们能够提高防守，那么我们拿三分回家的希望就会增加。 “每个人都想得分，哈维（阿隆索）总是告诉我们，发生什么并不重要，你只需要集中注意力并融入比赛，你就会得分。 “这就是为什么我们这个赛季从一开始就进了很多球，因为我认为在前三名你可以创造很多东西。如果你创造了很多，你也会进很多球。”

news.title: Eidur Gudjohnsen: The ‘Blond Maradona’ Days
news.title_zh: 艾杜尔·古德约翰森：“金发马拉多纳”时代
news.body_en: On the day our Chelsea legend Eidur Gudjohnsen turns 48, we remember his time playing for us as a deep-lying creative midfielder, and a very good one at that... After Chelsea’s 3-1 away win at West Ham in January 2006, the media wanted to know how our then-manager Jose Mourinho planned to cope with the loss of Michael Essien to what looked like a nasty injury 12 minutes into the match. The Blues manager directed their attention to the man who had replaced him in the centre of our midfield, Eidur Gudjohnsen, declaring that he had resembled a ‘blond Maradona’ that afternoon. It was the headline-grabbing moment of Gudjohnsen’s deep-lying creative phase for Chelsea, but by then he had been playing there for almost a year. For all that we will remember the Icelander as one of the club’s great strikers, his spell in that more withdrawn role was a fascinating departure for one of the most versatile and technically gifted players of the modern era. Gudjohnsen’s midfield experiment began in a high-stakes game: the League Cup final, in February 2005. At half-time in Cardiff, we trailed Liverpool 1-0 and looked out of sorts. It was the first really concerning period of a season that had been largely plain sailing for us. The previous two games had ended in defeat: first to Newcastle in the FA Cup, then to Barcelona in the first leg of a Champions League last 16 tie. It finally gave the outside world the opportunity to ask questions of Chelsea – were we capable of responding to this wobble? Had our opponents worked us out? To answer that question, we have to look at the way we were playing that season. First things first, we had switched to a staggered system, with Claude Makelele sitting deeper than the rest of the midfield, giving us an immediate numerical advantage in the middle of the pitch over teams playing the typical English 4-4-2 system of the time. After starting with a diamond midfield, and achieving functional, if unspectacular success, Mourinho decided to move to a 4-3-3 system, which could become a 4-5-1 when we were on the back foot. That meant sacrificing a centre-forward and playing with wide attacking players, who could stretch the opposition by going wide and trying to find the lone striker with balls into the box, which was the aim when Didier Drogba played up top. Alternatively, those wide players could look to run beyond a deeper centre-forward and make the most of his clever touches and through balls, as they did when Gudjohnsen was chosen to lead the line. The Icelander’s eventual withdrawal into midfield was the result of several combined factors. The first was the unavoidable reality that only one of he and Drogba could play up front at any given time. Then there was the fact that the third midfield berth, alongside Frank Lampard, in advance of Makelele, was up for grabs. Tiago played there most often in 2004/05, but Geremi and Alexey Smertin also had a look-in early in the season. All of them had done a job, but there was certainly room for a more artistic option. Finally, there came a time when our opponents began to man-mark Makelele in order to stop him from picking the ball up from the back four and beginning our attacking moves. To counteract this irritation, we needed an alternative outlet in midfield who was comfortable receiving the ball facing his own goal and turning to kick-start our attacking momentum, thereby taking the onus of the now-occupied Makelele. Moving Gudjohnsen into the midfield solved all three of those situations quite nicely, completing the tactical solution that Mourinho later explained in Gianluca Vialli and Gabriele Marcotti’s book, The Italian Job. ‘Look, if I have a triangle in midfield – Claude Makelele behind and two others just in front – I will always have an advantage against a pure 4-4-2 where the central midfielders are side by side,’ he said. ‘That’s because I will always have an extra man. It starts with Makelele, who is between the lines. If nobody comes to him he can see the whole pitch and has time. If he gets closed down it means one of the two other central midfielders is open. If they are closed down and the other team’s wingers come inside to help, it means there is space now for us on the flank, either for our own wingers or for our full-backs. There is nothing a pure 4-4-2 can do to stop things.’ Armed with this insight, let’s go back to the Millennium Stadium on 27 February 2005, where you will remember we were behind to a John Arne Riise goal in the League Cup final. Sensing the need for more creativity, more attacking impetus, Mourinho made a couple of brave substitutions. He took off the functional Jiri Jarosik, who had been making up the midfield trio with Makelele and Lampard, and replacing him with scheming forward Gudjohnsen. On 74 minutes he withdrew defender William Gallas and brought on another striker, Mateja Kezman, to partner Drogba up top, meaning we appeared to be playing with three at the back and two up front in the final stages. It worked. Our pressure produced an equaliser – an own goal from Steven Gerrard at precisely the time he was rumoured to be on the verge of agreeing to join us at the end of the season – which took the game to extra time, where goals from Drogba and Kezman gave us a 3-2 win and our first trophy under the ownership of Roman Abramovich. ‘It worked quite well!’ he said of his performance. ‘It’s easy to overlook it because you don’t see my name on the scoresheet, but some of the games I’ve played without goals have been up to a very high standard, and that’s one of them. A lot of people came up to me and complimented me, not just for playing in midfield but for actually changing the game.’ Gudjohnsen had been a revelation in midfield, and he spent much of the rest of the season in there, helping to connect the defensive half of our team – the back four plus Makelele – with the attacking half – the front three plus a shuttling Lampard. ‘Me and Frankie started developing a good relationship, running off each other,’ he said in an interview in 2006. ‘I used to fill in when he went forward, and vice versa.’ He was rewarded with his first league winners’ medal to add to the League Cup success a few months earlier, shortly before we overcame the first leg deficit against Barcelona in dramatic fashion at Stamford Bridge to continue our Champions League run. ‘I enjoyed the deeper role,’ Gudjohnsen said in an interview with the Official Chelsea website in 2017. ‘We had the perfect striker to be on his own up front which was Didier. We had Makelele, we had Frank, and me in a sort of half-advanced position. I knew Frank made a lot of runs, so I had to be careful I wasn’t too advanced. It worked well. I played in the same position against Barcelona and that worked, so it was gradually becoming my position, as in “I’m a midfielder now”.’ The following season, Gudjohnsen had yet more competition for places. Hernan Crespo and Carlton Cole returned from loan spells to make it four centre-forwards vying for one spot, while Michael Essien added a new element to the midfield alongside Makelele and Lampard. Gudjohnsen was only called upon to reprise his creative role when Essien suffered that injury at West Ham in January 2006. Yet, despite his starring role in the 3-1 win at Upton Park, capped off with the most beautifully-weighted through ball for Drogba to score the clincher, Gudjohnsen soon found another new arrival vying for his spot, as Mourinho’s former Porto player, Maniche, signed on a short-term deal. It proved to be Gudjohnsen’s final season at Stamford Bridge and he started fewer league games than he had in any of his previous five with the club, beginning just 16 of our 38 Premier League matches as we successfully defended our title. That summer he moved to Barcelona, demonstrating not only his technical prowess, but also the esteem in which he was held within the game. In total he made 163 appearances for Chelsea between 2000 and 2006, scoring 78 goals and winning two league titles, the League Cup and two Community Shields. 'Not bad for a boy from a little island up north!' as he put it when that list was put to him upon his departure. Perhaps that goals tally would have been slightly higher had he spent his entire time here as a forward, but then we wouldn’t have had the memories of the ‘blond Maradona’ pulling the strings and carrying the ball between the lines.
news.body_zh: 在我们的切尔西传奇人物埃杜尔·古德约翰森 48 岁生日的那天，我们记得他作为一名后撤的创造性中场球员为我们效力的时光，而且是一位非常出色的中场球员……2006 年 1 月切尔西客场 3-1 战胜西汉姆联队后，媒体想知道我们当时的主教练何塞·穆里尼奥计划如何应对迈克尔·埃辛在比赛开始 12 分钟时因严重受伤而离场的情况。蓝军主教练将注意力转向了取代他的中场核心埃杜尔·古德约翰森，并宣称他那天下午就像“金发马拉多纳”。这是古德约翰森在切尔西的深层创造力阶段的引人​​注目的时刻，但那时他已经在那里效力了近一年。尽管我们会记住这位冰岛人是俱乐部最伟大的前锋之一，但对于现代最全能、技术最有天赋的球员之一来说，他在这个更加内向的角色中的表现是一次令人着迷的离开。古德约翰森的中场实验始于一场高风险的比赛：2005 年 2 月的联赛杯决赛。在卡迪夫的半场比赛中，我们 1-0 落后利物浦，看上去状态不佳。这是一个赛季中第一个真正令人担忧的时期，对我们来说基本上是一帆风顺的。此前两场比赛均以失败告终：先是在足总杯中输给了纽卡斯尔，然后是在欧冠16强首回合中输给了巴塞罗那。这终于让外界有机会向切尔西提出问题——我们有能力应对这种不稳定吗？我们的对手打败了我们吗？要回答这个问题，我们必须看看我们那个赛季的比赛方式。首先，我们改用了交错阵型，克劳德·马克莱莱的位置比中场其他球员更深，这让我们在中场的位置比当时采用典型英格兰 4-4-2 阵型的球队拥有直接的人数优势。在从菱形中场起步并取得功能性（尽管并不引人注目）成功之后，穆里尼奥决定转向 4-3-3 体系，当我们处于不利地位时，该体系可能会变成 4-5-1。这意味着牺牲一名中锋并与边路进攻球员一起比赛，后者可以通过向边路延伸并试图找到将球送入禁区的单前锋来拉开对手的距离，这正是迪迪埃·德罗巴踢上前场时的目标。或者，这些边路球员可以寻求超越一名更深的中锋，并充分利用他的聪明触球和直塞球，就像古德约翰森被选为前锋线时所做的那样。冰岛人最终撤回中场是多种因素综合作用的结果。第一个是不可避免的现实，即在任何特定时间，他和德罗巴中只有一个人可以踢前锋。此外，第三个中场位置与弗兰克·兰帕德并列，排在马克莱莱之前，也有待争夺。蒂亚戈 (Tiago) 最常在 2004/05 赛季在那里踢球，但格雷米 (Geremi) 和阿列克谢·斯默廷 (Alexey Smertin) 也在赛季初曾到访过那里。他们所有人都完成了工作，但肯定还有更多艺术选择的空间。最后，我们的对手开始盯防马克莱莱，以阻止他从四后卫手中接球并开始我们的进攻。为了抵消这种刺激，我们需要在中场有一个替代的出路，他可以轻松地面对自己的球门接球，然后转身启动我们的进攻势头，从而承担现在占据的马克莱莱的责任。将古德约翰森移至中场很好地解决了这三种情况，完成了穆里尼奥后来在詹卢卡·维亚利和加布里埃尔·马科蒂的著作《意大利的工作》中解释的战术解决方案。 “看，如果我在中场有一个三角——克劳德·马克莱莱在后面，另外两个人在前面——我在面对中场球员并排的纯4-4-2阵型时总是有优势，”他说。 ‘那是因为我永远都会多一个男人。这要从马克莱莱开始，他是在字里行间。如果没有人来找他，他就能看到整个球场并且有时间。如果他被封堵，就意味着另外两名中场球员之一处于空位。如果他们被逼抢，对方的边锋内切提供帮助，这意味着我们的侧翼现在有空间，无论是我们自己的边锋还是我们的边后卫。 纯粹的 4-4-2 阵型无法阻止一切。”带着这样的洞察力，让我们回到 2005 年 2 月 27 日的千禧体育场，在那里你会记得我们在联赛杯决赛中落后于约翰·阿尔内·里瑟 (John Arne Riise) 的进球。穆里尼奥意识到需要更多的创造力和更多的进攻动力，因此做出了几次勇敢的换人。他撤掉了与马克莱莱和兰帕德组成中场三人组的功能型吉里·雅罗西克，并用狡猾的前锋古德约翰森取而代之。第 74 分钟，他撤回了后卫威廉·加拉斯，并换上了另一名前锋马特贾·凯日曼，与德罗巴搭档顶上，这意味着我们在最后阶段似乎是三后卫、两名前锋。它起作用了。我们的压力造就了扳平比分的机会——史蒂文·杰拉德的乌龙球，当时有传言称他即将同意在赛季末加盟我们——这使得比赛进入加时赛，德罗巴和凯日曼的进球帮助我们以3-2获胜，也是我们在阿布拉莫维奇执教下的第一座奖杯。 “效果非常好！”他谈到自己的表现时说道。 “很容易忽视这一点，因为你在记分表上看不到我的名字，但我参加过的一些没有进球的比赛已经达到了非常高的标准，这就是其中之一。很多人都来找我，称赞我，不仅仅是因为我在中场踢球，而是因为他实际上改变了比赛。”古德约翰森在中场发挥了重要作用，他在本赛季余下的大部分时间里都在那里度过，帮助我们球队的防守半场——后卫四人加上马克莱莱——与进攻半场——前锋三人加上穿梭的兰帕德。 “我和弗兰基开始发展出良好的关系，互相追逐，”他在 2006 年的一次采访中说道。“当他前进时，我常常顶替，反之亦然。”几个月前，就在我们在斯坦福桥以戏剧性的方式克服了对巴塞罗那的首回合落后，继续我们的冠军联赛之旅之前不久，他获得了他的第一枚联赛冠军奖牌，为联赛杯的成功增添了色彩。 “我喜欢这个更深的角色，”古德约翰森在 2017 年接受切尔西官方网站采访时说道。“我们有一位完美的前锋可以独自一人在前场，那就是迪迪埃。”我们有马克莱莱​​，我们有弗兰克，而我处于半领先的位置。我知道弗兰克跑了很多次，所以我必须小心，不要太领先。效果很好。我在对阵巴塞罗那的比赛中踢过同样的位置，这很有效，所以它逐渐成为我的位置，就像“我现在是一名中场球员”一样。接下来的赛季，古德约翰森的位置竞争更加激烈。克雷斯波和卡尔顿·科尔租借回归，四名中锋争夺一个位置，而迈克尔·埃辛则与马克莱莱和兰帕德一起为中场增添了新元素。 2006年1月，当埃辛在西汉姆联队受伤时，古德约翰森才被要求重新扮演他的创造性角色。然而，尽管古德约翰森在3-1战胜厄普顿公园的比赛中扮演了主角，最后为德罗巴打进了关键的一记漂亮的直塞球，但古德约翰森很快就发现了另一位新来者来争夺他的位置，穆里尼奥的前波尔图球员马尼切签下了一份短期合同。事实证明，这是古德约翰森在斯坦福桥的最后一个赛季，他在俱乐部的前五个赛季中首发的联赛次数更少，在我们的 38 场英超联赛中只首发了 16 场，而我们成功卫冕了冠军。那年夏天，他转会到巴塞罗那，不仅展示了他的技术实力，还展示了他在比赛中受到的尊重。 2000年至2006年间，他总共为切尔西出场163次，打进78球，赢得两次联赛冠军、联赛杯冠军和两次社区盾杯冠军。 “对于一个来自北方小岛的男孩来说，这还不错！” 正如他在离开时收到这份名单时所说的那样。如果他把整个时间都在这里作为前锋的话，也许进球数会更高一些，但那样我们就不会再有“金发马拉多纳”幕后操纵、在防线之间带球的记忆了。

news.title: Morgan Rogers in good company after impressive Chelsea start
news.title_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯在切尔西令人印象深刻的开局后得到了良好的陪伴
news.body_en: With his expertly taken goal against Hull City on Saturday, Morgan Rogers became just the fifth Chelsea player to score or assist in each of our first four games of a Premier League campaign. Rogers continued his impressive start to life at the Bridge by netting early in our 2-2 draw with the Tigers. It was his third of the season already, and his first strike on home soil. Having also assisted Pedro Neto in the win over Brighton, Rogers has a goal contribution to his name in every league fixture so far. Only his Blues team-mate Joao Pedro, with whom he has already linked up so well, has registered more combined goals and assists in the Premier League this term (six). And if you include the Carabao Cup, Rogers ranks top of all Premier League players for goals and assists after setting up half of the six we scored against Leeds in midweek. The attacker’s ten chances created in the Premier League is a figure bettered by only four players so far, while he ranks third for shots taken after a ball carry. It's been a very promising start to our new signing’s time as a Blue, and this achievement puts him in good company. Here are the four other Chelsea players who have also scored or assisted in our opening four fixtures of the campaign, starting with the first to do it… Drogba scored a hat-trick on the final day of the 2009/10 season to finish as the Premier League’s top goalscorer, and he picked up where he left off when the action resumed the following August. The Ivorian netted a treble on the opening day in a 6-0 thrashing of West Bromwich Albion. We won by the same scoreline at Wigan Athletic the following weekend, with Drogba providing a hat-trick of assists on that occasion. He then scored in a 2-0 win over Stoke, set up a goal in a 3-1 victory at Upton Park and, for good measure, created two more as we continued our blistering start to the season by beating Blackpool 4-0. Like Rogers, Cesc Fabregas wasted little time showing what he was capable of having left Barcelona for Chelsea in the summer of 2014. His assist for Andre Schurrle in our opening-day triumph at Burnley ranks among our very greatest in the Premier League era, and he also set up Branislav Ivanovic’s goal that day. Fabregas was at his creative best in each of our next three games, too, assisting goals in the wins over Leicester, Everton and Swansea City that maintained our flawless start to what would ultimately be a title-winning campaign. Diego Costa was the main beneficiary of Fabregas’ talent. The striker is the only player on this list to feature twice, with his start to life at the Bridge in 2014 especially eye-catching. After scoring on his debut – in that win at Burnley – and then his first outing on home soil, against Leicester, the Spain international bagged a brace in an epic 6-3 win over Everton and went one better the next weekend, taking home the match ball as Swansea were seen off 4-2. Fabregas set up three of those seven early-season goals. Two seasons later, Diego Costa repeated the trick, scoring against West Ham, Watford and Swansea, as well as laying on a goal for Willian in a victory over Burnley at the Bridge. Before Rogers, Eden Hazard was the most recent Chelsea player to score or assist in the first four league games of the season. The brilliant Belgian achieved that feat in his final year with the Blues. He created goals in the wins against Huddersfield and Arsenal that started life under Maurizio Sarri on a high, before finding the net himself as we defeated Newcastle United and Bournemouth. In our fifth game of that campaign, Hazard scored a treble against Cardiff City – something for Rogers to aim for when we meet Brentford on Friday!
news.body_zh: 凭借周六对阵赫尔城的精彩进球，摩根·罗杰斯成为第五位在英超联赛前四场比赛中均取得进球或助攻的切尔西球员。罗杰斯延续了他在蓝桥令人印象深刻的开局，在我们2-2战平老虎队的比赛中早早进球。这已经是他本赛季的第三个进球，也是他在家乡的第一次进球。罗杰斯还协助佩德罗·内托战胜布莱顿，迄今为止，他在每场联赛中都有进球贡献。只有他的蓝军队友若奥·佩德罗（他与他已经建立了如此密切的联系）本赛季在英超联赛中的综合进球和助攻数（6个）更多。如果算上卡拉宝杯的话，罗杰斯的进球数和助攻数在所有英超球员中名列前茅，周中对阵利兹联队的六粒进球中，罗杰斯贡献了一半。这名前锋在英超联赛中创造了十次机会，到目前为止，只有四名球员能够超越他，而他在带球后的射门方面排名第三。对于我们的新援作为蓝军来说，这是一个非常有希望的开始，这一成就让他有了很好的陪伴。以下是另外四名切尔西球员，他们在本赛季的前四场比赛中也取得了进球或助攻，从第一个进球开始……德罗巴在 2009/10 赛季的最后一天上演帽子戏法，成为英超联赛的最佳射手，并在次年八月比赛恢复时继续他的工作。科特迪瓦人在揭幕战当天以 6-0 击败西布罗姆维奇的比赛中攻入三冠王。接下来的周末，我们以同样的比分战胜了维冈竞技，德罗巴在那场比赛中上演了助攻帽子戏法。随后，他在 2-0 战胜斯托克城的比赛中进球，在 3-1 战胜厄普顿公园的比赛中攻入一球，此外，他还创造了两个进球，帮助我们以 4-0 击败布莱克浦，继续本赛季的强劲开局。和罗杰斯一样，法布雷加斯在 2014 年夏天离开巴塞罗那加盟切尔西后，很快就展现了自己的能力。在我们揭幕战战胜伯恩利的比赛中，他为安德烈·许尔勒送出的助攻堪称英超时代最伟大的助攻之一，当天他还助攻了布拉尼斯拉夫·伊万诺维奇的进球。法布雷加斯在接下来的三场比赛中也都发挥了他的最佳创造力，在战胜莱斯特城、埃弗顿和斯旺西城的比赛中助攻进球，帮助我们保持了完美的开局，最终赢得了冠军。迭戈·科斯塔是法布雷加斯天赋的主要受益者。这名前锋是这份名单上唯一一位两次出场的球员，他2014年在蓝桥的开局尤其引人注目。这位西班牙国脚在对阵伯恩利的比赛中首次亮相并取得进球，随后在主场对阵莱斯特城的比赛中首次亮相，这位西班牙国脚在一场史诗般的6-3战胜埃弗顿的比赛中梅开二度，并在接下来的周末取得更好的成绩，在斯旺西以4-2落败的情况下将比赛用球带回家。法布雷加斯在赛季初的七个进球中贡献了三个。两个赛季后，迭戈·科斯塔重复了这一招，在对阵西汉姆联、沃特福德和斯旺西的比赛中进球，并在蓝桥战胜伯恩利的比赛中为威廉攻入一球。在罗杰斯之前，阿扎尔是最近一位在本赛季前四场联赛中进球或助攻的切尔西球员。这位才华横溢的比利时人在蓝军的最后一年实现了这一壮举。他在对阵哈德斯菲尔德和阿森纳的比赛中创造了进球，在毛里齐奥·萨里的带领下开始了他的巅峰生涯，然后在我们击败纽卡斯尔联和伯恩茅斯的比赛中亲自进球。在我们该赛季的第五场比赛中，阿扎尔在对阵卡迪夫城的比赛中攻入三冠王——这是罗杰斯在周五对阵布伦特福德时的目标！

news.title: Chelsea international call-ups and schedules for September 2026
news.title_zh: 切尔西 2026 年 9 月国家队征召和赛程表
news.body_en: The first international break of the 2026/27 season will soon be upon us, when the Chelsea players called up will compete for their countries for the first time since the 2026 FIFA World Cup. This time around, it's a bumper extended international break, as a change to the FIFA calendar has combined the September and October windows into one two-week period, starting this season. That means two consecutive weekends without domestic football, instead featuring up to four matches for each national team, running between 21 September and 6 October. You can see a full breakdown of the Chelsea players called up by their countries so far and the games they will be hoping to feature in below, which will be updated as more nations confirm their squad. news.title: Bompastor on James’ new role and Potter's deserved opportunity
news.title_zh: 庞帕斯特谈詹姆斯的新角色和波特应得的机会
news.body_en: Following Chelsea Women’s brilliant 5-0 win over Manchester United, head coach Sonia Bompastor highlighted the performances of Lauren James and Lexi Potter. Bompastor made two changes to her line-up as we took the trip to Manchester looking for our first Women’s Super League win of the season, having been held to a 1-1 draw at Stamford Bridge by Aston Villa in our opening game. With Aggie Beever-Jones among the substitutes this time around, those changes saw James switching to a central striker’s role. It produced the desired results as the England international netted our third goal of a resounding victory over the Red Devils. ‘I think we all know LJ is probably not a real number nine and she likes to drop deep and have the ball,’ said Bompastor, after seeing her team pick up our first league win of the campaign in emphatic fashion. ‘So it's important when we play with LJ as a number nine to have two number tens who are in the pocket, but also making penetrating runs. That's why it's important for us to pay attention when we decide which profiles are playing around her. ‘It’s important to have this threat because I think on Sunday we could exploit the space behind the back line for United and we were quite good at doing that.’ The player who came into the line-up in place of Beever-Jones was Academy graduate Potter, the 20-year-old taking her spot in midfield for her first WSL start of the season, after impressing in the 1-0 UEFA Women’s Champions League win away at Real Sociedad. ‘I already said I am a manager who really likes to develop young players,’ Bompastor continued. ‘I want to give them the opportunity when they have the right mindset, they work hard and they have the quality. I'm always keen to do that. ‘Lexi deserves to get minutes in this team. She's a really good player. Sometimes it depends on the tactics, the different profiles we want to use and the different systems we are playing. ‘But it was a good opportunity for her and she had a good performance. That's the best thing she can do for me to keep her on the pitch.’
news.body_zh: 在切尔西女足 5-0 战胜曼联之后，主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特重点介绍了劳伦·詹姆斯和莱克西·波特的表现。在我们前往曼彻斯特寻求本赛季首场女足超级联赛胜利时，邦帕斯托对她的阵容做出了两项调整，我们在首场比赛中被阿斯顿维拉在斯坦福桥以 1-1 逼平。这次由于阿吉·比弗-琼斯成为替补，这些变化让詹姆斯转为中锋的角色。英格兰国脚打进了我们对红魔的第三个进球，取得了预期的结果。 “我想我们都知道 LJ 可能不是真正的九号位，她喜欢回撤并拿球，”邦帕斯特在看到她的球队以坚定的方式赢得我们本赛季的首场联赛胜利后说道。 “因此，当我们与LJ一起打9号位时，重要的是要有两名10号位在口袋里，同时还要进行突破性的跑动。这就是为什么当我们决定哪些个人资料在她周围播放时，我们必须注意这一点很重要。 “拥有这种威胁很重要，因为我认为周日我们可以为曼联利用后防线的空间，我们很擅长做到这一点。”代替比弗-琼斯进入阵容的球员是青训球员波特，这位20岁的球员在女足欧冠客场1-0战胜皇家社会的比赛中表现出色，在本赛季首次在女足超级联赛首发中占据中场位置。 “我已经说过，我是一名真正喜欢培养年轻球员的主教练，”邦帕斯特继续说道。 “当他们有正确的心态、努力工作并且有能力时，我想给他们机会。我总是热衷于这样做。 “莱克西值得在这支球队中获得上场时间。她是一位非常出色的球员。有时这取决于战术、我们想要使用的不同配置文件以及我们正在玩的不同系统。 “但这对她来说是一个很好的机会，她也有很好的表现。这是她能为我做的最好的事情，让她留在球场上。”

news.body_en: A 5-0 thrashing of Manchester United meant it was not easy to single out a star Chelsea Women performer, but Blues supporters have cast their decision. Our first WSL victory of the campaign was an emphatic one, with five different goalscorers ensuring it was a perfect afternoon in the North-West. news.title: How Ray Wilkins became Chelsea's youngest captain
news.title_zh: 雷·威尔金斯如何成为切尔西最年轻的队长
news.body_en: After only 28 Chelsea appearances, an 18-year-old Ray Wilkins was handed the Blues captaincy. On what would have been Ray's 70th birthday, we look back at a year in which Butch went from starting his first game to taking on the armband. When Ray Wilkins signed for Chelsea at the age of 10 on the same day as his namesake and future midfield partner, Ray Lewington, it seemed pretty clear to all concerned that the club had bagged themselves a superstar in the making. There was no hesitation when it came to thrusting him into the Blues’ first team. He was only 17 years old when he first started a game for Chelsea, in the pressure-cooker atmosphere of a London derby at White Hart Lane. Just over a year later, with 28 first-team appearances under his belt, he was asked to captain the side for the first time. Such a scenario would be unthinkable in the modern game, but even back in 1975 it was headline news. On the day of the Spurs game, the back page of the Daily Mirror led with: ‘Butch leads escape kids.’ Much of the focus within the article was on quotes from John Hollins, who remains the youngest Chelsea player to captain the side after deputising at the age of 18 years and three months – making him four months younger than Wilkins, who is our youngest permanent skipper. Hollins felt it was the end of an era for a number of the older guard at Chelsea, but in his first interview after taking on the role, Wilkins felt quite the opposite. ‘I won’t worry about having to ruck senior players like Ron Harris and David Hay,’ he told the Mirror. ‘In a match as important as this I’m sure it won’t be necessary anyway.’ Interestingly, considering his rapid elevation to captain, when looking back on his early experience of first-team football in an interview for Rhapsody in Blue, a book written in 1996 by Chelsea’s official historian Rick Glanvill, Wilkins recalled a feeling of awe when looking around the dressing room. ‘The squad at that time was one of immense talent,’ he said. ‘You looked around at the faces and thought, “I don’t think I should be here.” You did. I probably cleaned all their boots at some stage.’ Big changes were afoot at the Bridge, though. Alan Hudson, the most obvious barrier between Wilkins and a regular midfield spot, was sold to Stoke City after falling out with manager Dave Sexton. The gaffer would soon be on his way too, with his last game coinciding with Wilkins’ first appearance of the 1974/75 season at the end of September in a 1-0 home defeat to Wolves. Sexton’s assistant, Ron Suart, took charge of a financially stricken club that was sleepwalking towards the Second Division, but he soon made way for Eddie McCreadie, our former left-back who had stepped up to the coaching ranks. He immediately saw fit to hand a great deal of responsibility on a mature youngster who, as much as anything, would symbolically represent what he planned for Chelsea. Wilkins had no fear on the pitch, happily drifting behind the strikers – unlike the more conservative footballer he became in later years – and affecting the game in the final third, either by playing the killer through-ball or by ghosting into the box and finishing things off himself. ‘I think Eddie’s first action was to throw me in as captain,’ continues Wilkins in Rhapsody in Blue. ‘I said, “Are you sure?” because John Hollins was still at the club, Ron Harris was there, Catty Peter Bonetti was still there. But the response I got off those guys as just out of this world. ‘Instead of saying, “Oh, this young upstart, we’ll show him a thing or two!” all they did was rally round: “If we can help you out in any way, Ray, give us a shout.” And that is just top drawer.’ The Blues lost 2-0 and arguably the game’s biggest moment came between those two goals, when Wilkins missed a sitter after Pat Jennings had palmed a shot into his path. ‘I couldn’t believe it when he missed,’ said Spurs defender Cyril Knowles. ‘He seemed to kick straight across it.’ According to Mike Langley, writing for the Sunday People, Wilkins wept in the dressing room after the game before delivering a defiant message to journalists: ‘We’re not giving up. We must beat Sheffield United on Wednesday.’ Alas, we drew 1-1, as we did on the final day against Everton, despite a goal from our new skipper briefly handing us a fighting chance of a win which would give us a chance of staying up. We were relegated, sure, but with a charismatic Blues legend in the dugout and our talismanic young skipper ready to usher in a new era, we were down but far from out. Wilkins and McCreadie led us back to the top flight at the second time of asking and the captaincy brought the best out of one of English football’s brightest talents as he twice won the club’s Player of the Year award. He captained the club in 170 of his 198 appearances before our money woes, and another relegation, forced his sale to Manchester United in 1979.
news.body_zh: 仅仅为切尔西出场 28 次后，18 岁的雷·威尔金斯就被任命为蓝军队长。在雷的 70 岁生日那天，我们回顾了布奇从首发到戴上队长袖标的一年。当雷·威尔金斯 (Ray Wilkins) 10 岁那年与他的同名球员、未来的中场搭档雷·莱温顿 (Ray Lewington) 签约切尔西时，所有关注者都清楚地意识到，俱乐部已经成为了一名正在成长中的超级巨星。当他被推入蓝军一线队时，他毫不犹豫。当他第一次为切尔西首发时，年仅 17 岁，当时他正处于白鹿巷球场的伦敦德比战的高压气氛中。仅仅一年多后，在代表一线队出场 28 次后，他首次被任命为球队队长。这样的场景在现代足球比赛中是不可想象的，但即使在 1975 年，这也是头条新闻。热刺比赛当天，《每日镜报》的封底标题是：“布奇带领逃亡的孩子们。”文章中的大部分焦点都来自约翰·霍林斯的引述，霍林斯在 18 岁零 3 个月的时候担任队长，现在仍然是最年轻的切尔西球员，这使得他比我们最年轻的永久队长威尔金斯年轻了四个月。霍林斯认为，对于切尔西的一些老后卫来说，这是一个时代的结束，但在上任后的第一次采访中，威尔金斯的感觉恰恰相反。 “我不会担心必须与罗恩·哈里斯和大卫·海这样的资深球员较量，”他告诉《镜报》。 “在一场如此重要的比赛中，我确信无论如何都没有必要。”有趣的是，考虑到他迅速晋升为队长，威尔金斯在接受切尔西官方历史学家里克·格兰维尔于 1996 年撰写的《蓝色狂想曲》的采访中回顾自己早期在一线队的经历时，威尔金斯回忆起环顾更衣室时的敬畏之情。 “当时的球队是一支才华横溢的球队，”他说。 “你环顾四周，看着那些面孔，心想：‘我认为我不应该在这里。’”你做到了。我可能在某个阶段清理了他们所有的靴子。”不过，大桥正在发生巨大的变化。艾伦·哈德森是威尔金斯和常规中场位置之间最明显的障碍，在与主教练戴夫·塞克斯顿闹翻后被卖给了斯托克城。这位主帅也很快就要上场了，他的最后一场比赛恰逢威尔金斯在 1974/75 赛季首次亮相，那是在 9 月底，球队主场 1-0 输给了狼队。塞克斯顿的助手罗恩·苏尔特（Ron Suart）执掌了一家陷入财务困境的俱乐部，该俱乐部正在梦游般地迈向乙级联赛，但他很快就让位于埃迪·麦克雷迪（Eddie McCreadie），我们的前左后卫，他已晋升为教练。他立即认为将大量责任交给一名成熟的年轻人是合适的，他将象征性地代表他对切尔西的计划。威尔金斯在球场上无所畏惧，他快乐地游走在前锋身后——与他后来变得更加保守的足球运动员不同——并在最后三分之一的比赛中影响比赛，要么通过致命的直塞球，要么鬼鬼祟祟地进入禁区并亲自完成比赛。 “我认为埃迪的第一个行动就是让我担任队长，”威尔金斯在《蓝色狂想曲》中继续说道。 “我说，‘你确定吗？’”因为约翰·霍林斯还在俱乐部，罗恩·哈里斯也在那里，凯蒂·彼得·博内蒂也在那里。但我从那些人那里得到的回应却是绝无仅有的。 “而不是说，‘哦，这个年轻的暴发户，我们会给他看一两件事！’”他们所做的只是团结起来：“如果我们能以任何方式帮助你，雷，请大声喊我们。”蓝军以 2-0 落败，可以说，这场比赛最重要的时刻就发生在这两粒进球之间，帕特·詹宁斯 (Pat Jennings) 向威尔金斯 (Pat Jennings) 射门后，威尔金斯 (Wilkins) 错失了一个保姆球。 “当他投丢时，我简直不敢相信，”热刺后卫西里尔·诺尔斯说道。 “他似乎直接踢了过去。”据《星期日人民报》撰稿的迈克·兰利称，赛后威尔金斯在更衣室里哭泣，然后向记者传达了一个挑衅的信息：“我们不会放弃。”我们必须在周三击败谢菲尔德联队。遗憾的是，我们以 1-1 战平，就像我们在最后一天对阵埃弗顿时所做的那样，尽管我们的新队长的进球短暂地给了我们一个获胜的机会，这让我们有机会坚持下去。 当然，我们降级了，但教练席上有一位富有魅力的蓝军传奇人物，我们的年轻队长已经准备好迎接一个新时代，我们虽然落后了，但离出局还很远。威尔金斯和麦克雷迪在第二次要求时带领我们重返顶级联赛，队长的身份让英格兰足球最聪明的天才之一发挥出了最好的水平，他两次赢得了俱乐部的年度最佳球员奖。在俱乐部出场 198 场比赛中，他以队长身份出战 170 场，随后我们的资金困难和另一次降级迫使他于 1979 年被出售给曼联。

news.title: Chelsea Diary: Action-packed week!
news.title_zh: 切尔西日记：充满活力的一周！
news.body_en: Here is everything to look out for at Chelsea in the coming week, with five games taking place across our men's, women's and Academy sides! You can get more reaction from Sonia Bompastor after CFCW put on a five-star display in Manchester to beat United 5-0, with goals coming from Sjoeke Nusken, Keira Walsh, Lauren James, Ellie Carpenter and Lucy Bronze. Make sure you catch the match in its full 90-minute glory, available exclusively to CFC+ subscribers! Cobham Next Gen are in EFL Trophy action on Tuesday night as they travel to Adams Park to take on Wycombe Wanderers following a penalty shoot-out success in our first fixture in the competition at Bristol Rovers. Kick-off in Buckinghamshire is set for 7pm and supporters can follow events with minute-by-minute updates in our Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website, while those in the UK can watch the match on Sky Sports+. We take another step closer to a busy few days of match action, with every Chelsea side continuing their pre-match preparation at our Cobham training centre. As our men's side look to bounce back from our 2-2 draw with Hull last weekend, manager Xabi Alonso will be back in the press conference hot seat as he prepares to preview our visit to Brentford. As always, you can see it live on the Chelsea Official App and website, or watch it back in full later in the day. The Blues will make the short trip to the Gtech Community Stadium as Alonso's men prepare to take on Brentford with kick-off scheduled for 8pm on Friday evening. The game will be broadcast in the UK on Sky Sports, but you can follow along with us in our Brentford vs Chelsea Match Centre, where we will be providing live updates of all the build-up, action and reaction direct from west London. We will also bring you the best of the action in our highlights from two hours after full-time, followed by the full 90 minutes of action soon after, before the Blues head off for the international break. To begin your action-packed Saturday, you can get all the reaction to the men's result across the Chelsea Official App and website, where we'll have an exclusive post-match interview with Xabi and one of his players following Friday night. There is also live football for you to enjoy as Chelsea Under-18s host Bournemouth in the Under-18 Premier League, hoping to maintain their impressive form after they put five past Brighton last Saturday. The game begins at 11am and CFC+ subscribers can watch it live in our Chelsea Under-18s v Bournemouth Match Centre. The full 90 minutes will also be available to watch back for CFC+ subscribers after the game. At 12.45pm, Chelsea take on Birmingham City at the Bridge in the Barclays Women's Super League. Tickets are still available to buy, while if you can't get down to the Bridge you can follow all the action with minute-by-minute updates in our Chelsea Women vs Birmingham City Women match centre, and in the UK watch it live on Sky Sports. Highlights will be available from four hours after full-time, with in-game clips available on our official CFCW v Birmingham City matchday story, available exclusively on the Chelsea Official App. Cobham Next Gen are also in action on Saturday afternoon. Following the trip to Wycombe, we host Fulham at our Cobham training centre, with kick-off set for 3pm. news.title: Wieke Kaptein on how 'not stressing' led to Man Utd win
news.title_zh: Wieke Kaptein 谈“无压力”如何帮助曼联获胜
news.body_en: Wieke Kaptein explained how our 5-0 win away at Manchester United was the result of the whole team pulling in the same direction to overcome a lack of goals seen in the first Women's Super League match of the season against Aston Villa. We came away with a 1-1 draw against Aston Villa at Stamford Bridge last weekend, despite dominating possession and creating plenty of chances to score. The Netherlands international explained the elements the side worked hard on in training in the week leading up to the clash against Man United and was proud of her teammates for turning things around so quickly. ‘I think it was a really good team performance, to be honest,’ Kaptein reflected afterwards. ‘Everyone was working really hard and kept possession. We needed to score goals today, and I think we did that very well. ‘We kept possession a little bit longer, saw where the spaces were, and then I think a lot of people were in front of the goal today, which was really good. So every time they came across or when there was an opportunity, I think everyone was ready for it. ‘We trained really hard on that one, in terms of the crosses and keeping possession. Everyone won it, really, today.’ While the team were naturally disappointed not to take all three points on the opening day of the campaign, the Blues quickly put the result to bed and sought to make the necessary improvements. Kaptein, who created four chances and completed eight out of 12 duels attempted at the Progress With Unity Stadium, thought the finishing was the necessary finishing touch after last week’s draw. ‘I think we needed to score a lot of goals today,’ she said. ‘We were a bit in our heads when we drew 1-1 against Aston Villa and had a lot of chances. We said to each other as a team that we don't need to stress about it. ‘We had a good performance last week, to be honest. We just needed to score, and I think that's what we did today.’
news.body_zh: Wieke Kaptein 解释了我们客场 5-0 战胜曼联的原因，是全队齐心协力克服了本赛季首场女足超级联赛对阵阿斯顿维拉时缺乏进球​​的情况。上周末，我们在斯坦福桥以 1-1 战平阿斯顿维拉，尽管我们占据了控球权并创造了大量进球机会。这位荷兰国脚解释了球队在对阵曼联的比赛前一周努力训练的内容，并为她的队友们如此迅速地扭转局面感到自豪。 “说实话，我认为这是一场非常出色的团队表现，”卡普坦事后回忆道。 “每个人都非常努力并保持控球权。今天我们需要进球，我认为我们做得很好。 “我们把控球时间延长了一点，看看哪里有空间，然后我认为今天很多人都在球门前，这真的很好。所以每次遇到或者有机会的时候，我想每个人都已经做好了准备。 “我们在这方面训练非常努力，包括传中和控球。今天，每个人都赢了。”虽然球队自然对未能在赛季首日全取三分而感到失望，但蓝军很快就解决了这一问题，并寻求做出必要的改进。卡普坦在进步团结体育场的 12 次对决中创造了 4 次机会并完成了 8 次，他认为这次终结是上周平局后必要的点睛之笔。 “我认为我们今天需要进很多球，”她说。 “当我们1-1战平阿斯顿维拉时，我们有点头脑清醒，并且有很多机会。作为一个团队，我们互相说我们不需要为此感到压力。 “说实话，我们上周表现不错。我们只需要得分，我想这就是我们今天所做的。

news.title: Sonia Bompastor gives Naomi Girma injury update and praises finishing
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托 (Sonia Bompastor) 向娜奥米·吉尔玛 (Naomi Girma) 通报伤情并赞扬完成比赛
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor explained why Naomi Girma was missing from the squad and praised her side’s ability to convert our chances after our 5-0 win over Manchester United on Sunday. Goals from Sjoeke Nusken, Keira Walsh, Lauren James, Ellie Carpenter and Lucy Bronzed capped off an afternoon in which the Blues dominated the opposition and responded to Bompastor’s call for them to be more clinical with their finishing following our 1-1 draw with Aston Villa last weekend. Striker Melvine Malard was missing with injury against her former side, and the head coach explained why Naomi Girma was also missing from Sunday’s teamsheet. ‘Naomi just picked up a small injury,’ said Bompastor. She maybe won't be available for the next weeks. It’s unfortunate, but hopefully she'll be back soon.' Any frustration from the stalemate at Stamford Bridge last weekend was soon forgotten as we quickly took charge of the match against Man United. Bompastor explained the difference between the two matches and expressed her delight at the response from the players after they were left disappointed not to take maximum points from Aston Villa. ‘I think in this game, the big difference from last weekend was us being able to convert and to score the goals during our strong moments in the game,' she said. 'I’m also happy we started strong and sustained the intensity throughout the game, which is something we need to do when I'm talking to you about the mentality and the mindset. 'You can’t think it’s enough when you are winning one-nil. Not in this league, against all the teams you are playing against. I'm quite happy with the reaction we had from last weekend.' Playing her 50th match for the Blues and her 100th overall game in the Women’s Super League was midfielder Walsh. The England international marked the occasion with a stunning strike from outside the box and an assist for James in our third goal of the afternoon, and Bompastor discussed how the Chelsea coaching staff have been encouraging Walsh to shoot. ‘I'm really happy with Keira,’ continued the head coach. ‘She's one of these players and leaders in my team who really sets the tone for the way we want to play. She controls and manages the game in a perfect way in terms of how I want the team to play. In possession of the ball, she's really good. We are really encouraging her to take opportunities from the edge of the box. ‘She has a great shot, and she still has more to come. It’s a case of her being confident, and today she was unbelievable. Many other players were also unbelievable. I think even out of possession today we were a good team. The counter-press was good, the intensity was high, and even when we lost the ball, we reacted quickly. We always put the United players under pressure everywhere on the pitch. ‘There are some good learnings for us to take for our confidence, but we're still early in the season, and now it's up to us to be able to sustain those types of performances.’
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特解释了娜奥米·吉尔玛缺席球队的原因，并赞扬了她的球队在周日 5-0 战胜曼联后抓住机会的能力。斯约克·努斯肯、凯拉·沃尔什、劳伦·詹姆斯、艾莉·卡彭特和露西·古龙泽德的进球为整个下午的比赛画上了圆满的句号，蓝军在上周末1-1战平阿斯顿维拉后，也回应了邦帕斯特要求他们更加冷静的呼吁。前锋梅尔文·马拉德在对阵前东家的比赛中因伤缺席，主教练解释了为什么娜奥米·吉尔玛也缺席了周日的球队名单。 “娜奥米刚刚受了点小伤，”邦帕斯特说。她可能在接下来的几周内都没有空。这很不幸，但希望她能尽快回来。”上周末斯坦福桥的僵局带来的任何挫败感很快就被忘记了，因为我们很快就掌控了对阵曼联的比赛。邦帕斯特解释了两场比赛之间的差异，并对球员们因未能从阿斯顿维拉队获得最高分而感到失望后的反应表示高兴。 “我认为在这场比赛中，与上周末最大的不同是我们能够在比赛的强势时刻转化并进球，”她说。 “我也很高兴我们开局强劲，并在整场比赛中保持了强度，这是当我和你谈论心态和心态时我们需要做的事情。 “当你以一比零获胜时，你不能认为这已经足够了。不是在这个联盟中，而是针对所有与你比赛的球队。我对上周末的反应感到非常满意。”中场球员沃尔什参加了她为蓝军效力的第 50 场比赛，也是她在女足超级联赛中的第 100 场比赛。这位英格兰国脚在禁区外射出一记惊人的进球，并在我们下午的第三个进球中为詹姆斯助攻，邦帕斯特讨论了切尔西教练组如何鼓励沃尔什射门。 “我对凯拉真的很满意，”主教练继续说道。 “她是我球队中的球员和领导者之一，真正为我们想要的比赛方式定下了基调。她以完美的方式控制和管理比赛，符合我希望球队打球的方式。在控球方面，她确实表现出色。我们真的鼓励她从禁区边缘抓住机会。 “她有一个很棒的机会，而且她还有更多的机会。这是她自信的表现，今天她的表现令人难以置信。其他不少玩家也是难以置信。我认为即使今天失去控球权，我们也是一支优秀的球队。反击很好，强度很高，即使丢球，我们的反应也很快。我们总是让曼联球员在球场上的任何地方都承受压力。 “我们可以吸取一些很好的教训来增强信心，但我们还处于赛季初期，现在取决于我们是否能够维持这些类型的表现。”

news.title: Keira Walsh on 'amazing feeling' of reaching 50 appearances for Chelsea
news.title_zh: 凯拉·沃尔什谈为切尔西出场 50 场的“奇妙感觉”
news.body_en: Keira Walsh marked her 50th appearance for the Blues with a stunning strike from outside the box and an assist in our 5-0 victory against Manchester United. It was a happy day for the Blues midfielder as she netted one of her trademark goals from range on her 50th outing for Chelsea and also passed the 100-appearance marker in the Women's Super League. The England international moved to Chelsea from Barcelona at the end of January 2025 and made her Blues debut two days later in a 1-0 win away at Aston Villa. Walsh soon became a regular in our starting XI and helped us to a domestic Treble at the end of her first campaign in Blue. The midfield playmaker has now scored four goals for the Blues during her half-century of appearances 'Playing that many games for such a good club is obviously an amazing feeling,' said Walsh upon reaching the milestone. 'Winning the league was a highlight for me because it's not an easy league to win, and that's what I came here to do. 'The Chelsea fans have really welcomed me from when I first came and always supported the way that I've played. I want to keep playing good football, enjoying it, and hopefully reach 100 in blue.' In addition to her 50 Chelsea appearances, Walsh has amassed 103 senior England caps, winning the Women's European Championship in 2022 and 2025 and reaching the Women's World Cup final in 2023.
news.body_zh: 凯拉·沃尔什 (Keira Walsh) 代表蓝军出场 50 次，在我们 5-0 战胜曼联的比赛中，她凭借禁区外的精彩射门和助攻。对于这位蓝军中场来说，这是快乐的一天，她在代表切尔西出场的第 50 场比赛中攻入了标志性的远射进球，同时也突破了在女足超级联赛中出场 100 场的记录。这位英格兰国脚于2025年1月底从巴塞罗那转会至切尔西，两天后在客场1-0战胜阿斯顿维拉的比赛中完成了她的蓝军首秀。沃尔什很快就成为我们首发阵容中的常客，并在她在蓝色队的第一个赛季结束时帮助我们获得了国内三冠王。这位中场组织核心在她半个世纪的出场时间里已经为蓝军打进了四个进球“为如此优秀的俱乐部踢了这么多场比赛显然是一种令人惊奇的感觉，”沃尔什在达到这一里程碑时说道。 “赢得联赛冠军对我来说是一个亮点，因为赢得联赛冠军并不容易，而这就是我来这里的目的。 “从我第一次来切尔西的时候起，切尔西球迷就非常欢迎我，并且一直支持我的踢球方式。我想继续踢出漂亮的足球，享受它，并希望能达到蓝色的100分。”除了为切尔西出场 50 次之外，沃尔什还为英格兰国家队出场 103 次，赢得了 2022 年和 2025 年女足欧洲锦标赛冠军，并进入了 2023 年女足世界杯决赛。

news.title: Match Report: Manchester United 0-5 Chelsea
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：曼联0-5切尔西
news.body_en: Keira Walsh scored and assisted on her 50th Blues appearance as Chelsea delivered a 5-0 away win at Manchester United in the Women's Super League. We faced a new-look Manchester United side who were led by new boss Eva Olid after they had parted ways with their head coach Marc Skinner in the summer, following his five-year spell in charge of the club. After an initial exchange of chances, Chelsea began to assert our dominance in the game. It was Sjoeke Nusken – playing in a more advanced role than normal – who opened the scoring with a composed finish from a Wieke Kaptein assist. Doubling our advantage on the half-hour mark was Keira Walsh, who let fly with a powerful drive into the bottom corner to take a firm grip of the contest. The home side worked hard but were no match for the Blues, and Lauren James put us three goals to the good with a clinical finish after an hour. Ellie Carpenter then ended all hope of a comeback for the Red Devils when she kept her head to finish her own rebound, putting us 4-0 up. We added our fifth and final goal from a corner routine. Bronze reacted first to pick up the ball in the box, and the left-back smashed home from close range to complete the rout. The team answered Bompastor's call for them to be more clinical after last week's draw with Aston Villa, Walsh grabbed a goal and an assist on her 50th Chelsea appearance, and there were also Women's Super League debuts for substitutes Giulia Dragoni and Nelly Las in a day that was packed with positives. Bompastor made two changes to her starting XI ahead of this clash, switching Veerle Buurman for Kadeisha Buchanan and bringing in Chelsea Academy graduate Lexi Potter in place of striker Aggie Beever-Jones. Alongside Potter in the midfield was the experienced Walsh, who passed the 50-appearance marker for Chelsea with her place in the starting line-up. On the bench was defender Nathalie Bjorn, having made her recovery from a lengthy injury layoff. When the match kicked off, it was clear that the versatile Nusken had been deployed in an advanced attacking role, with James in the central striker position. Both sides traded chances in the early stages of the encounter, as Elisabeth Terland tested the gloves of Hannah Hampton, while Katie McCabe made life difficult for Phallon Tullis-Joyce with a cross-cum-shot which dipped dramatically and went just over the bar. With 15 minutes gone, Potter played a neat sideways pass into James on the left-hand side, for the No.10 to swing in a cross to the far post to pick out Wieke Kaptein. The Netherlands international's headed effort was collected gratefully by Tullis Joyce, but there were signs the Blues were finding the spaces in attack. We breached the home side's defences after a prolonged spell of pressure and neat play around the penalty area with 20 minutes gone. Kaptein capitalised on a moment of hesitation in the opposition backline and fed the ball to Nusken, and the Germany international slotted home with a composed finish. Our defence had to switch on to protect our advantage minutes later, when Buchanan made a perfectly timed sliding block inside the penalty area to put the ball out for a corner. The Blues continued to dominate possession and drove forward with every given opportunity. And when Bronze played the ball to international team-mate Walsh on the edge of the box, the midfielder seized her chance to drill the ball towards goal. The shot was as clean as they come, and it flew into the bottom corner to mark Walsh's 50th Chelsea appearance in style. With the half-time whistle approaching, James saw her curling effort palmed away by Tullis-Joyce, before Carpenter had a close-range shot well blocked on the follow-up. The Blues were hungry for more after the break. James struck the ball into the danger area, but Alyssa Thompson couldn't quite get there for what would've been an easy tap-in as it trickled along the goal-line. The American then switched roles with the No.10 as she got round her marker on the left and put a cross in, but Thompson couldn't direct her shot goalwards. Yet it wasn't long before James had her second in as many WSL matches. Played in with a killer pass from Walsh, the forward slotted home with confidence, getting her just reward for an excellent display. With the home side disheartened, Chelsea pushed on. Carpenter found herself in a position to shoot and initially stung the gloves of Tullis-Joyce, but when the rebound fell nicely at her feet, she had the opportunity to have another go and this time side-footed her shot into the back of the net. Substitute Sandy Baltimore also went close later on, and Buchanan slid in with another incredible block at the other end as the match ended with Man United limited to just two shots on goal by the Blues backline. Deep into stoppage time, Bronze scored her first of the campaign with an emphatic finish from close-range. This was a truly dominant display from Chelsea, one that will give Bompastor and her team confidence as we move forward in the new campaign. We take our points tally to four after our first two WSL matches of the season. We return to Stamford Bridge in WSL action when we face Birmingham City next Saturday lunchtime, with kick-off set for 12.45pm. news.body_zh: 凯拉·沃尔什在女足超级联赛中第 50 次为蓝军出场，进球并助攻，帮助切尔西客场 5-0 战胜曼联。我们面对的是一支面貌焕然一新的曼联球队，他们由新主帅埃娃·奥利德领导，他们在夏天与主教练马克·斯金纳分道扬镳，此前他执掌俱乐部五年。在初步交换机会后，切尔西开始确立比赛的主导地位。斯乔克·努斯肯（Sjoeke Nusken）——扮演比平常更靠前的角色——在维克·卡普坦（Wieke Kaptein）的助攻下以冷静的射门首开纪录。凯拉·沃尔什 (Keira Walsh) 在半小时内将我们的优势加倍，她一记强力射门飞入底角，牢牢掌控了比赛。主队奋力拼搏，但仍无法与蓝军相抗衡，劳伦·詹姆斯在一小时后以冷静的进球帮助我们取得了三个进球。埃莉·卡彭特随后冷静地完成了自己的篮板球，帮助我们4-0领先，终结了红魔翻盘的所有希望。我们在角球例行比赛中添加了第五个也是最后一个进球。青铜率先反应在禁区内接球，左后卫近距离破门完成溃败。上周与阿斯顿维拉战平后，球队响应了邦帕斯托要求他们更加冷静的号召，沃尔什在第 50 次为切尔西出场时攻入一球并助攻一次，替补球员朱莉娅·德拉戈尼和内莉·拉斯也完成了女子超级联赛的首秀，这一天充满了积极的一面。在这场比赛之前，邦帕斯特对她的首发阵容做出了两次调整，将维尔勒·布尔曼换成卡德伊沙·布坎南，并用切尔西学院毕业生莱克西·波特代替前锋阿吉·比弗-琼斯。中场与波特并肩的是经验丰富的沃尔什，她在首发阵容中为切尔西出场50次。替补席上的是后卫纳塔莉·比约恩(Nathalie Bjorn)，她刚刚从长时间的伤病休养中恢复过来。比赛开始后，很明显，多才多艺的努斯肯被安排在前锋位置，而詹姆斯则担任中锋位置。双方在比赛的早期阶段就互相交换了机会，伊丽莎白·特兰德（Elisabeth Terland）测试了汉娜·汉普顿（Hannah Hampton）的手套，而凯蒂·麦凯布（Katie McCabe）的一记交叉射门大幅下降并刚刚高出横梁，为法伦·图利斯·乔伊斯（Phallon Tullis-Joyce）制造了麻烦。比赛还剩 15 分钟时，波特巧妙地侧身传球给左侧的詹姆斯，10 号球员传中到远门柱，接住了维克·卡普坦 (Wieke Kaptein)。这位荷兰国脚的头球被图利斯·乔伊斯感激地接住，但有迹象表明蓝军正在寻找进攻空间。比赛还剩 20 分钟时，经过长时间的压力和在禁区附近的漂亮表现，我们突破了主队的防线。卡普坦利用对方后防线的犹豫，将球传给努斯肯，这位德国国脚以冷静的射门破门得分。几分钟后，我们的防守必须开启以保护我们的优势，当时布坎南在禁区内完美地完成了一次滑行挡球，将球开出角球。蓝军继续掌控控球权，并抓住每一个机会向前推进。当布朗兹在禁区边缘将球传给国家队队友沃尔什时，这位中场球员抓住了机会将球射向球门。射门干净利落，飞入底角，标志着沃尔什第 50 次为切尔西出场。随着半场哨声的临近，詹姆斯看到她的弧线射门被图利斯-乔伊斯挡出，随后卡彭特的近距离射门被挡出。中场休息后，蓝军渴望更多。詹姆斯将球击入危险区域，但艾莉莎·汤普森无法完全到达那里，因为球沿着球门线缓缓流过。随后，美国人与 10 号球员交换了角色，她绕过左侧的盯防者并传中，但汤普森无法将射门射向球门。然而没过多久，詹姆斯就在 WSL 比赛中获得了第二个进球。接到沃尔什的致命传球后，这名前锋充满信心地破门，为她的出色表现赢得了应有的回报。由于主队心灰意冷，切尔西继续前进。 卡彭特发现自己处于射门位置，一开始刺伤了图利斯-乔伊斯的手套，但当篮板正好落在她脚下时，她有机会再次射门，这次侧脚射门入网。替补球员桑迪·巴尔的摩随后也险些进球，而布坎南在另一端又完成了一次令人难以置信的拦网，最终比赛结束，曼联的蓝军后防线只射门两次。伤停补时阶段，布隆泽近距离射门打进了她本赛季的首个进球。这是切尔西真正具有统治力的表现，这将给邦帕斯特和她的球队带来信心，让我们在新赛季继续前进。在本赛季的前两场 WSL 比赛之后，我们的积分达到了 4 分。下周六午餐时间我们将回到斯坦福桥参加 WSL 比赛，对阵伯明翰城，开球时间为中午 12 点 45 分。切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特（Las 84）、青铜（c）、布坎南、麦凯布（布尔曼 70）、沃尔什、努斯肯、卡普坦（德拉戈尼 80）、波特、詹姆斯（巴尔的摩 71）、汤普森（滨野 71）未上场替补：彭、比约恩、比弗-琼斯得分手：努斯肯 21、沃尔什 news.title: Confirmed Chelsea Women lineup vs Manchester United
news.title_zh: 确认切尔西女足对阵曼联的阵容
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has made two changes to her Chelsea side for our WSL clash against Manchester United at the Progress With Unity Stadium. After our opening-day draw against Aston Villa at Stamford Bridge, we now go in search of three points away at Manchester United on Sunday lunchtime. Bompastor has handed Keira Walsh her 50th Chelsea appearance as the experienced playmaker makes today's starting XI. Joining her in the midfield is 20-year-old Chelsea Academy graduate Lexi Potter, who comes into the side for Aggie Beever-Jones. Kadeisha Buchanan also gets her first league start of the season as she begins the match in place of Veerle Buurman. Having now recovered from the injury sustained during our 2-0 Women's League Cup final victory against Man United, Nathalie Bjorn is back among the substitutes for today's game. Chelsea: Hampton, Carpenter, Bronze (c), Buchanan, McCabe, Walsh, Nusken, Kaptein, Potter, James, Thompson Chelsea substitutes: Peng, Buurman, Bjorn, Dragoni, Las, Hamano, Baltimore, Beever-Jones
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托 (Sonia Bompastor) 对她的切尔西阵容做出了两项调整，以应对在团结体育场 (Progress With Unity Stadium) 对阵曼联的 WSL 比赛。在斯坦福桥揭幕战战平阿斯顿维拉后，我们现在将在周日午餐时间客场挑战曼联，争取三分。庞帕斯特已经让凯拉·沃尔什第 50 次在切尔西出场，这位经验丰富的组织核心将成为今天的首发阵容。与她一起踢中场的是 20 岁的切尔西学院毕业生莱克西·波特 (Lexi Potter)，他与阿吉·比弗·琼斯 (Aggie Beever-Jones) 并肩作战。卡黛莎·布坎南 (Kadeisha Buchanan) 也代表维尔勒·布尔曼 (Veerle Buurman) 首发出场，这是她本赛季的首次联赛首发。娜塔莉·比约恩在我们2-0战胜曼联的女足联赛杯决赛中受伤，现在已经康复，她又回到了今天比赛的替补席上。切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特、青铜（中）、布坎南、麦凯布、沃尔什、努斯肯、卡普坦、波特、詹姆斯、汤普森 切尔西替补：彭、布尔曼、比约恩、德拉戈尼、拉斯、哈马诺、巴尔的摩、比弗-琼斯

news.title: Chavarria on working hard to solve problems
news.title_zh: 查瓦里亚努力解决问题
news.body_en: Pep Chavarria felt it was another strong attacking display from Chelsea against Hull City, but we need to work hard on the training pitch to sure up our defence in future. Despite taking an early lead through Morgan Rogers on Saturday, two goals in six minutes left the Blues chasing the game in the second half. We got back on level terms thanks to Joao Pedro’s third Premier League goal of the season, but had to settle for a 2-2 draw at the final whistle. It’s important to remember the context, as the Tigers remain unbeaten in the league and were yet to concede a goal this season until their visit to Stamford Bridge. However, for Chavarria, the lesson to take from this match was clear. ‘It was a difficult game. Of course, Hull is a very good team,’ said our Spanish full-back. ‘I think that when we scored the first goal we controlled the game, but when they equalised Hull did good things. Our team is very competitive and we always have a lot of energy to score goals, but we need to defend better, I think that is the key. ‘Hull want to play long balls and box-to-box. It's difficult because you stay in their area and then you need to defend in our area. They like to run and you need to defend those actions. ‘I think that the team did a good game, but we conceded two goals, so we need to work hard and we need to solve the problems.’ Chavarria came off the bench at half-time to make his fourth Premier League appearance since joining the Blues from Rayo Vallecano this summer. Although it wasn’t enough to take all three points, the 28-year-old felt the way we came out swinging for the second half demonstrated why he is so pleased to be at Chelsea, where he is settling in well. ‘I think that in the second half we had more energy, more intensity, to win the duels,’ he continued. ‘This team has a lot of talent and it's a pleasure to play with these top players, because we have a lot of alternatives and solutions. ‘For me it's a dream to be here and I'm very happy. I feel very good now and I think that the adaptation is good.’
news.body_zh: 佩普·查瓦里亚认为这是切尔西对阵赫尔城的又一次强势进攻表现，但我们需要在训练场上努力，以确保我们未来的防守。尽管摩根·罗杰斯在周六早早取得领先，但六分钟内的两粒进球让蓝军在下半场追赶着比赛。凭借若奥·佩德罗本赛季的第三个英超进球，我们扳平了比分，但在终场哨声响起时我们不得不以 2-2 战平。记住当时的背景很重要，因为老虎队在联赛中保持不败，并且本赛季在造访斯坦福桥之前尚未失球。然而，对于查瓦里亚来说，从这场比赛中吸取的教训是显而易见的。 ‘这是一场艰难的比赛。当然，赫尔城是一支非常优秀的球队，”我们的西班牙后卫说道。 “我认为，当我们打进第一个进球时，我们控制了比赛，但当他们扳平赫尔城时，我们做得很好。我们的球队很有竞争力，我们总是有很大的能量去进球，但我们需要更好地防守，我认为这是关键。 “赫尔城想要打长传和禁区。这很困难，因为你呆在他们的区域，然后你需要在我们的区域防守。他们喜欢跑步，你需要捍卫这些行为。 “我认为球队踢得很好，但我们丢了两个球，所以我们需要努力工作，需要解决问题。”查瓦里亚在半场替补出场，这是他自今年夏天从巴列卡诺加盟蓝军以来第四次参加英超联赛。尽管还不足以全取三分，但这位 28 岁的球员感觉我们下半场的表现证明了他为何如此高兴来到切尔西，他在切尔西已经适应得很好。 “我认为下半场我们有更多的能量、更强的强度来赢得对决，”他继续道。 “这支球队拥有很多天赋，很高兴与这些顶级球员一起比赛，因为我们有很多选择和解决方案。 “对我来说，来到这里是一个梦想，我很高兴。我现在感觉很好，我认为适应很好。”

news.title: Alonso outlines how time will help Blues learn and improve
news.title_zh: 阿隆索概述了时间将如何帮助蓝军学习和进步
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has reiterated that his Chelsea side must continue to ‘learn from everything’ after our draw with Hull City, but has emphasised that the Blues will only continue to improve in time. Our latest Premier League outing ended in what the Spaniard admitted was a disappointing result. We had taken the lead against the Tigers at Stamford Bridge yesterday, with Morgan Rogers firing us into a seventh-minute lead. However, two goals in the space of six first-half minutes from Mohamed Belloumi put Hull ahead at the interval. The Blues then had to battle back into the contest. We managed to pull level through a fine Joao Pedro finish and pushed hard for a winner. Yet Hull, who hadn’t conceded a goal in the top flight before their trip to west London, were resolute to earn a share of the points. The draw means the Blues have taken seven points from our opening four Premier League games. It’s a solid start, although one Alonso knows could have been better. However, with less than a month of competitive football played, the Spaniard appreciates it’s natural there is still plenty of room for improvement during the season. He said: ‘It’s early days for us. It’s one month together and in one month, we know the idea, the concepts, the mentality, but it’s too early to know it’s already built. ‘It will take longer, but we need to learn from everything and from this [against Hull] as well. ‘For sure, I think it will come. At the moment, we are not having that feeling we are solid enough. With work and with games, I think it will get better.’ On the defensive frailty of his side, which has seen the Blues concede at least twice in all of our Premier League matches this term, Alonso added: ‘Overall, I think we are attacking better than we are defending. In every aspect, so we know that it’s a big topic and a theme for us. ‘For sure, it’s just four games, but the dynamic in terms of conceding, I don’t like it and we to do much better. Open play, set-pieces, long balls, this toughness and competitive sense, we can do better.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索重申，在与赫尔城战平后，他的切尔西队必须继续“从一切中学习”，但他强调蓝军只会及时继续进步。我们最近的英超联赛以西班牙人承认的令人失望的结果告终。昨天我们在斯坦福桥对阵老虎队时取得了领先，摩根·罗杰斯在第七分钟为我们取得了领先。然而，穆罕默德·贝卢米在上半场六分钟内攻入两球，帮助赫尔城在中场休息时取得领先。蓝军随后不得不重新投入比赛。我们通过若奥·佩德罗的精彩射门扳平了比分，并努力争取胜利。然而，在前往西伦敦之前，赫尔城在顶级联赛中没有丢过一球，他们决心要分享积分。这场平局意味着蓝军在我们的前四场英超比赛中已经拿到了七分。这是一个坚实的开始，尽管阿隆索知道可以做得更好。然而，由于比赛时间还不到一个月，西班牙人很自然地意识到本赛季仍有很大的进步空间。他说：“对我们来说现在还为时尚早。在一起一个月，在一个月内，我们知道了这个想法、概念和心态，但现在知道它已经建成还为时过早。 “这将需要更长的时间，但我们需要从一切中吸取教训，也从这次（对阵赫尔城）中吸取教训。 “当然，我认为它会到来。目前，我们还没有感觉到我们足够坚固。通过工作和比赛，我认为情况会变得更好。”谈到球队的防守弱点，阿隆索补充道：“总的来说，我认为我们的进攻比防守更好。”从各个方面来说，我们都知道这对我们来说是一个大话题和主题。 “当然，这只是四场比赛，但失球的动态，我不喜欢它，我们应该做得更好。开放式比赛、定位球、长传，这种韧性和竞争意识，我们可以做得更好。”

news.title: Joao Pedro: We need to improve on the details
news.title_zh: 若昂·佩德罗：我们需要改进细节
news.body_en: Joao Pedro believes Chelsea made a strong start against Hull City, but need to improve quickly to avoid dropping more points after having to settle for just one in Saturday’s Premier League meeting with the Tigers. Not for the first time this season, the Blues began the match on the front foot and, as the game approached the half-hour mark, there was little sign of what was to come. Morgan Rogers fired us into a seventh-minute lead after being found on the edge of the box by Joao Pedro, but two quick-fire Hull goals left us trailing, until the Brazilian smashed an equaliser into the roof of the net. We couldn’t find a third goal to take all three points, the game ending in a 2-2 draw, leaving the Blues determined to keep improving to do better next time out. ‘I think we started really well,’ reflected Joao Pedro. ‘We put pressure on them, we controlled the game, but we need to improve on the details because I think in the end, this point is very important for us. So we need to analyse and improve. ‘We have to adapt quickly, as soon as possible, because we know how the Premier League is. If you drop points, in the end it will be difficult to recover. We need to adapt quickly because if you want to compete, you have to improve on that. ‘We knew if they got in front they were going to sit at the back and wait for us to come and play for the counter-attack. It was a tough game. ‘In the end, we could get one point, but like I said, we need to improve and I think we're going to improve soon.’ It was another fine individual performance from Joao Pedro, the August Premier League Player of the Month taking his tally to three goals and three assists in four games in that competition this season. Again, he was helped by the instant connection he has developed with fellow forwards Palmer and Rogers, as shown when the former provided the low cross for the equaliser. ‘When Cole passed to me I just tried to hit it on target and I was very happy to hit a good shot,’ the striker continued. ‘I enjoy [playing with Palmer and Rogers] a lot because they are very good players and I know when we play close, we can be very dangerous. We showed that again. So I enjoy it a lot and hopefully we can continue to improve even more.’ Joao Pedro also responded to the comparison made by Xabi Alonso on Friday between our Brazilian and the France and Real Madrid legend Karim Benzema. ‘I think maybe the style, the way I play – I like to come deep and I like to link up with my team-mates,’ he added. ‘But, of course, Benzema is on another level. ‘I just try to enjoy every game and try to help my team with goals or assists. I'm in a very good moment and I'm very happy.’
news.body_zh: 若昂·佩德罗相信切尔西在对阵赫尔城的比赛中取得了良好的开局，但在周六与老虎队的英超比赛中只获得一分后，需要迅速提高以避免丢更多分。蓝军在比赛中取得领先，这已经不是本赛季第一次了，当比赛接近半小时时，几乎没有任何迹象表明接下来会发生什么。摩根·罗杰斯在禁区边缘被若昂·佩德罗发现后，为我们取得领先，但赫尔城的两粒快速进球让我们落后，直到巴西人将比分扳平。我们没能找到第三个进球来全取三分，比赛最终以 2-2 平局告终，这让蓝军决心不断进步，争取在下次比赛中做得更好。 “我认为我们的开局非常好，”若昂·佩德罗反映道。 `我们向他们施加了压力，我们控制了比赛，但我们需要改进细节，因为我认为最终，这一点对我们来说非常重要。所以我们需要分析和改进。 “我们必须尽快适应，因为我们知道英超联赛的情况。如果掉分的话，最后就很难挽回了。我们需要快速适应，因为如果你想竞争，你就必须改进。 “我们知道，如果他们在前面，他们就会坐在后面，等待我们的反击。这是一场艰难的比赛。 “最后，我们可以拿到一分，但就像我说的，我们需要进步，我认为我们很快就会进步。”这是若昂·佩德罗的又一出色个人表现，他是八月英超最佳球员，在本赛季的四场比赛中，他的进球数达到了三球，助攻三次。他与前锋帕尔默和罗杰斯建立的即时联系再次帮助了他，正如前者为扳平比分提供低传中所显示的那样。 “当科尔传球给我时，我只是试图击中目标，我很高兴击中一脚好球，”这位前锋继续说道。 “我非常喜欢（与帕尔默和罗杰斯一起比赛），因为他们是非常优秀的球员，我知道当我们打得很接近时，我们会非常危险。我们再次证明了这一点。所以我很喜欢它，希望我们能够继续进步。”若昂·佩德罗还回应了哈维·阿隆索周五对我们的巴西人、法国人和皇家马德里传奇人物卡里姆·本泽马进行的比较。 “我想也许是我的风格，我的比赛方式——我喜欢深入，我喜欢与我的队友联系，”他补充道。 “但是，当然，本泽马处于另一个层面。 “我只是努力享受每场比赛，并努力帮助我的球队进球或助攻。我现在正处于一个非常美好的时刻，我很高兴。”

news.body_en: Supporters at Stamford Bridge have certainly not been starved of entertainment this season. Unfortunately, the Blues' latest back-and-forth game ended with Hull City leaving west London with a 2-2 draw and a point. Xabi Alonso's side had, once again, made an impressive start. We were ahead inside seven minutes against the Tigers, as Morgan Rogers collected a Joao Pedro pass and slammed home a finish at the near post. The Blues appeared in control of the game, but two quick-fire Hull goals from Mohamed Belloumi meant we trailed at the break. Another comeback was required if we were to win. We got halfway there. In the 66th minute, Joao Pedro drove a left-footed strike into the net after a cross from Cole Palmer. Further chances came and went in the time that remained. Yet on this occasion, we couldn't find a winner as Hull held on for a share of the spoils. Alonso made two changes to the side that started our last Premier League outing at Arsenal. Josh Acheampong and Maxence Lacroix stepped out of the back line, with Malo Gusto and Levi Colwill coming in. The Blues set up with a back four ahead of Emi Martinez. Wesley Fofana and Jorrel Hato were included in defence alongside Gusto and Colwill, Reece James partnered Romeo Lavia in midfield, while Pedro Neto, Cole Palmer, Rogers and Joao Pedro were in our attack. Hull arrived at Stamford Bridge having not conceded in their opening three games. Alonso's side, meanwhile, have developed a habit of scoring early this term – and we did so once more. Just seven minutes had elapsed when Palmer collected possession in the Hull half and fed a pass into the feet of Joao Pedro. The Brazilian turned and moved the ball to Rogers, who shifted it onto his left foot and drove a near-post shot beyond Konstantinos Tzolakis. Going behind didn't alter Hull's approach. The Tigers sat deep and attempted to soak up pressure. It left few gaps for the Blues to exploit, but a chance was fashioned for Neto after the ball was won back in midfield. It enabled the Blues to counter and after Joao Pedro found the Portuguese winger breaking into the penalty area, Neto tried to guide a shot into the far corner. Tzolakis was alert, though, and pushed the attempt wide. From set-pieces, we carried a threat. One low James cross into the near-post was guided narrowly wide by Neto, while our skipper came close with a whipped delivery that Tzolakis saved. As the goalkeeper looked to restart play, he collided with Colwill and needed treatment. It proved a turning point in the half. After the stoppage, Tzolakis restarted the game. He punted the ball long and Hull wing-back Ryan Giles chased it to the byline and hooked it into the Chelsea penalty area. Hato misjudged the flight, and then the bounce, and Belloumi was able to power a measured strike beyond Martinez. The unexpected goal swung momentum in Hull's favour and the visitors took full advantage by grabbing a quick-fire second. Colwill had done excellently to deflect a goal-bound shot from Lewie Coyle behind, but from the resulting corner a Semi Ajayi header struck the crossbar. The rebound fell to McBurnie and he teed up Belloumi, whose shot was deflected on its way into the net. Hull's six-minute gut-punch blunted the Blues for the remainder of the half. A Gusto shot deflected wide and a late corner cleared behind from under his crossbar by a Hull defender was the best we offered. At the interval, Alonso introduced Pep Chavarria for Hato. The shape stayed the same, but there was greater urgency to our possession. Rogers' physicality when running with the ball was causing problems for the Hull back line, and he was fouled twice in quick succession. James took both free-kicks. The Chelsea captain tried to catch out Tzolakis at his near-post first, before he whipped another attempt from 25 yards over the wall and toward the top corner. The Hull goalkeeper clawed it away. After a break in play following a collision of heads involving Joao Pedro and Nobel Mendy, the Tigers fashioned a chance. Regan Slater was given time to line up a shot and he powered the ball at Martinez, who beat the effort away and then reacted well to stop the ball from reaching Oli McBurnie. Hull's backline was proving difficult to break down. But with 24 minutes to play, we found a way through. Palmer claimed the assist, as he drove to the byline down the Blues' left and crossed low for Joao Pedro. The ball was slightly behind the Brazilian, yet he readjusted expertly and drilled a left-footed finish into the roof of the net. The Blues were level and there was plenty of time to fashion a winner. Given Hull's resilience, that wouldn't be easy, and Alonso introduced Valentin Barco and Danny Welbeck for Lavia and Gusto to try to help us find a way through. Hull's threat diminished as the game moved closer to a conclusion. We had chances, with James having a low shot saved and Palmer guiding an attempt over from inside the penalty area. The best opportunity for a Blues winner fell to Rogers. After a Hull break was snuffed out by Colwill, he broke forward, found Welbeck, who passed to Palmer. The England international evaluated his options and spotted Rogers racing forward. Palmer's pass was on point and Rogers controlled and fired at goal. Unfortunately, it was too close to Tzolakis, who saved. Hull, meanwhile, almost snatched all three points in the final minutes, as a ball across the box was met by Mohamed-Ali Cho. His attempt was on target but Martinez was down to save. Six minutes were added. Estevao, introduced late on, worked Tzolakis at his near post. The Brazilian then forced a late penalty appeal for handball against Ajayi. Nothing was given. There was one last opportunity. After a break led by Estevao was halted on the edge of the Hull box, we were awarded a free-kick 20 yards from goal. Palmer lined it up. It would be the final chance of the game. Unfortunately, Palmer's effort was too high and the referee followed it with the full-time whistle. The points were shared. The Blues sit fourth in the Premier League table, with seven points secured from our opening four matches. Alonso's side have a free week before we make the short journey to the Gtech Community Stadium to face Brentford on Friday evening. Kick-off at our west London neighbours is at 8pm. news.body_zh: 斯坦福桥的球迷本赛季当然不会缺乏娱乐。不幸的是，蓝军最近的一场交锋最终以赫尔城2-2战平西伦敦并拿下一分而告终。哈维·阿隆索的球队再次取得了令人印象深刻的开局。在对阵老虎队的比赛中，我们在七分钟内就取得了领先，摩根·罗杰斯接到若奥·佩德罗的传球，并在近门柱处射门得分。蓝军似乎控制了比赛，但穆罕默德·贝卢米的两粒快速赫尔进球意味着我们在中场休息时落后。如果我们想要获胜，就需要再次翻盘。我们已经到了一半了。第66分钟，科尔·帕尔默传中，若昂·佩德罗左脚射门入网。在剩下的时间里，更多的机会来了又去。然而这一次，我们无法找到胜利者，因为赫尔城坚持分享战利品。阿隆索对我们上一场英超对阵阿森纳的首发阵容做出了两项调整。乔什·阿奇姆蓬 (Josh Acheampong) 和马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦 (Maxence Lacroix) 退出后防线，马洛·古斯托 (Malo Gusto) 和利维·科尔威尔 (Levi Colwill) 上场。蓝军在埃米·马丁内斯 (Emi Martinez) 之前设置了四后卫。韦斯利·福法纳和乔雷尔·哈托与古斯托和科尔威尔一起防守，里斯·詹姆斯在中场搭档罗密欧·拉维亚，而佩德罗·内托、科尔·帕尔默、罗杰斯和若昂·佩德罗在我们的进攻中。赫尔城抵达斯坦福桥后，在前三场比赛中没有失球。与此同时，阿隆索的球队已经养成了在本学期早些时候进球的习惯——我们再次这样做了。仅仅过了七分钟，帕尔默就在赫尔城半场控球，并将球传给若奥·佩德罗脚下。巴西人转身将球传给罗杰斯，罗杰斯将球转移到左脚，近门柱射门越过了康斯坦丁诺斯·佐拉基斯。落后并没有改变赫尔的做法。老虎队坐稳并试图吸收压力。这给蓝军留下了很少的空档，但内托在中场夺回球权后创造了机会。这使得蓝军得以反击，在若奥·佩德罗发现葡萄牙边锋突入禁区后，内托试图将射门射入远角。不过，佐拉基斯很警惕，并将射门推向了外侧。从定位球开始，我们就构成了威胁。詹姆斯一脚低传到近门柱，内托将球稍稍偏出，而我们的队长则差点将球传出，被佐拉基斯扑出。当守门员试图重新开始比赛时，他与科尔威尔相撞并需要治疗。事实证明，这是上半场的转折点。暂停后，佐拉基斯重新开始比赛。他长距离踢球，赫尔城边后卫瑞恩·贾尔斯将球追至边线，并将球勾入切尔西禁区。哈托错误地判断了飞行，然后弹跳，贝卢米能够在马丁内斯身后进行有节奏的打击。这个出人意料的进球让赫尔城的势头向有利的方向转变，客队充分利用了优势，迅速获得了第二个机会。科尔威尔出色地挡住了路易斯·科伊尔身后的射门，但在角球中，塞米·阿贾伊的头球击中了横梁。篮板球落到了麦克伯尼身上，他将贝卢米扶上球台，贝卢米的射门在入网时被偏转。赫尔城的六分钟重击让蓝军在下半场剩余时间里表现不佳。加斯托的射门偏出偏出，最后角球被赫尔城后卫从横梁下解围，这是我们提供的最好的选择。中场休息时，阿隆索为哈托换下了佩普·查瓦里亚。形状保持不变，但我们拥有它的紧迫性更大。罗杰斯带球跑动时的身体素质给赫尔城后防线带来了麻烦，他连续两次被犯规。詹姆斯主罚了两个任意球。切尔西队长首先试图在近门柱接住佐拉基斯，然后他从人墙外 25 码处再次射门，飞向顶角。赫尔城门将将球扑出。若昂·佩德罗和诺贝尔·门迪发生头部碰撞，比赛暂停后，老虎队创造了一次机会。雷根·斯莱特获得了一次射门的时间，他将球传给了马丁内斯，马丁内斯将球挡出，然后做出了良好的反应，阻止了球到达奥利·麦克伯尼的手中。事实证明，赫尔城的后防线很难被打破。但在比赛还剩 24 分钟时，我们找到了出路。帕尔默获得助攻，他带球突破蓝军左侧底线，低传给若昂·佩德罗。 球稍稍落后于巴西人，但他熟练地进行了调整，并用左脚将球射入了网顶。蓝军打得很平，有足够的时间来打造胜利者。考虑到赫尔城的韧性，这并不容易，阿隆索为拉维亚和古斯托引进了瓦伦丁·巴科和丹尼·维尔贝克，试图帮助我们找到出路。随着比赛接近尾声，赫尔城的威胁逐渐减弱。我们有机会，詹姆斯的低射被扑出，帕尔默在禁区内引导射门高出。蓝调冠军的最佳机会落在了罗杰斯身上。在赫尔城的破门被科尔威尔扼杀后，他向前突破，找到了维尔贝克，维尔贝克将球传给了帕尔默。这位英格兰国脚评估了他的选择，并发现罗杰斯正在向前推进。帕尔默的传球恰到好处，罗杰斯控制住并射门。不幸的是，距离佐拉基斯太近，佐拉基斯扑救。与此同时，赫尔城在最后几分钟几乎全取三分，球穿过禁区被穆罕默德·阿里·乔接住。他的射门正中目标，但马丁内斯被扑救。增加了六分钟。后来介绍的埃斯特沃在佐拉基斯的近处工作。随后，巴西人因对阿贾伊的手球而被迫提出上诉。什么也没给。还有最后一次机会。在埃斯特沃带领的一次破门被赫尔城禁区边缘阻挡后，我们获得了距球门 20 码处的任意球。帕尔默把它排成一行。这将是比赛的最后机会。不幸的是，帕尔默的射门太高，裁判吹响了全场哨。要点被分享了。蓝军在英超积分榜上排名第四，前四场比赛积七分。阿隆索的球队有一周的空闲时间，然后我们将在周五晚上前往 Gtech 社区体育场迎战布伦特福德。我们伦敦西部邻居的比赛将于晚上 8 点开始。切尔西（4-2-3-1）：马丁内斯；古斯托 (维尔贝克 78)、福法纳 (拉克鲁瓦 86)、科尔威尔、哈托 (查瓦里亚 46)；詹姆斯 (c)、拉维亚 (Barco 70)；罗杰斯、帕尔默、内托（Estevao 86）；若昂·佩德罗未上场替补：彭德斯、阿奇姆蓬、奎恩达、吉滕斯得分手：罗杰斯 7、若昂·佩德罗 66 黄牌：巴可 80 赫尔城 (5-4-1)：佐拉基斯；科伊尔（诺顿-卡菲 82）、阿贾伊、伊根、门迪、贾尔斯； Belloumi (Cho
